Name in Other Languages

Korean

별빛정원을 노니는
(byolbitjjongwoneul nonineun)

“ These flowers hold the stories of stars! „

Starshine Garden (Korean: 별빛정원을 노니는, byolbitjjongwoneul nonineun) is Hydrangea Cookie's second Costume, released in the first half of the Yakgwa Village: Haunting Tales update. It is a Super Epic Costume that was only obtainable through exchanging 1,500 Grand Champions League Tokens during the GCL Token Exchange Shop! event during the associated event period.

Story

The Starshine Garden is blooming with Starflowers all year round. And there, you can meet Hydrangea Cookie tending to the garden. She prefers to relax with the butterflies rather than fight like other Cookies. Hydrangea Cookie just wants to stroll along this tranquil promenade!

Trivia

  • Starshine Garden was released alongside  Moonlit Nightwalk Guide,  Lighthearted Poet,  Misty Trail Hermit,  Strange Reappearance,  Glistening Thread, and  Starshine Garden Hopper.

Name in Other Languages

Korean

백련성 최고관리
(baengnyonssong chwegogwalri)
"Top Manager of the Lotus Palace"

“ I will always stand by the Great Dragon's side! „

Lotus Palace's Best Employee (Korean: 백련성 최고관리, baengnyonssong chwegogwalri, "Top Manager of the Lotus Palace") is Hydrangea Cookie's first Costume, released in the second half of the Rise of the Blue Dragon update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Oh, majestic Blue Dragon, heed my words and tread carefully, for danger lurks around every corner! As the best employee of the Lotus Palace, it is the Cookie's duty to adorn the armors with the most exquisite lotus petals and leaves that bloom at dawn. So let us keep our sight firmly ahead and move forward fearlessly...!

Trivia

  • Lotus Palace's Best Employee was released alongside  Slithering Strategist.
